title: Quiz 2 — Philippine Geology & Biodiversity
revision: 2026-11 rev2 — 70:30 LOTS:HOTS, balanced choices, in-scope items only

questions.text: What happens at a convergent plate boundary?
options: Plates move toward each other
Plates move away from each other
Plates slide past each other sideways
Plates stay perfectly still forever
questions.correct: Plates move toward each other

questions.text: Which layer do tectonic plates move over?
options: Asthenosphere
Inner core
Outer core
Crust only (top layer)
questions.correct: Asthenosphere

questions.text: Why does the Philippines have many active volcanoes?
options: Subducting plates beneath them produce magma
The islands sit on a divergent ridge in the ocean
Hot ocean water melts the rocks along the coast
Typhoons bring heat that melts the mountains
questions.correct: Subducting plates beneath them produce magma

questions.text: What is the Philippine Trench?
options: A deep trench where a plate subducts
A long, wide river valley in central Luzon
A canal dug for ships between islands
A shallow reef area off Palawan
questions.correct: A deep trench where a plate subducts

questions.text: Which kind of motion happens along the Philippine Fault Zone?
options: Blocks slide horizontally past each other
Plates pull apart to form a new ocean
One plate sinks straight into the mantle
Magma pours out along the fault all year round
questions.correct: Blocks slide horizontally past each other

questions.text: Which evidence shows that some Philippine mountains were once under the sea?
options: Marine fossils and limestone up high
Snow found on top of the highest peaks
Rivers that flow down to the sea
Volcanic ash on the slopes of mountains
questions.correct: Marine fossils and limestone up high

questions.text: Why are parts of Palawan geologically different from Luzon's volcanic arc?
options: They are continental pieces from Asia
They were formed only by very recent eruptions
They are made entirely of floating pumice rock
They rose from the sea floor during a typhoon
questions.correct: They are continental pieces from Asia

questions.text: A map shows earthquakes getting deeper as you move west from the Philippine Trench. What does this tell a geologist?
options: A plate is sinking at an angle beneath the islands
The islands are slowly floating eastward on the water
Earthquakes happen only near the surface of land
The trench is quickly filling with river sediment
questions.correct: A plate is sinking at an angle beneath the islands

questions.text: Why does the Philippines have both many volcanoes AND many strong earthquakes?
options: It lies on converging plates and active faults
It lies far away from any plate boundary on Earth
It receives very heavy rain every single year
It has many rivers that shake the ground
questions.correct: It lies on converging plates and active faults

questions.text: A town plans to build a new school directly on a mapped active fault line because the land is cheap. Which judgment is BEST?
options: Unsafe — choose a site away from the fault
Safe — faults only move once every million years
Safe — buildings on faults are always stronger
Unsafe — but only because the land is too cheap
questions.correct: Unsafe — choose a site away from the fault

questions.text: How many climate types does PAGASA use for the Philippines?
options: Four
Two
Three
Five
questions.correct: Four

questions.text: Which monsoon brings cool, drier air from about November to February?
options: Amihan
Habagat
Trade wind
Sea breeze
questions.correct: Amihan

questions.text: How were the Chocolate Hills of Bohol formed?
options: Uplifted, eroded limestone
Lava domes that cooled quickly
Soil piled up by early farmers
Sand dunes blown in by the wind
questions.correct: Uplifted, eroded limestone

questions.text: What does it mean when a species is endemic to the Philippines?
options: It is found naturally only in the Philippines
It has spread to almost every country in the world
It was brought in from another country
It has been extinct for many centuries
questions.correct: It is found naturally only in the Philippines

questions.text: Why do the Philippines have so many endemic species?
options: Isolated islands let species evolve apart
The islands are all connected by bridges
The climate is cold and dry all year
Animals are brought in from other countries
questions.correct: Isolated islands let species evolve apart

questions.text: Which landform is human-made?
options: Banaue Terraces
Mayon Volcano
Chocolate Hills
Tubbataha Reefs Park
questions.correct: Banaue Terraces

questions.text: What is the MAIN threat to Philippine biodiversity?
options: Habitat loss
Too much rainfall
Cold weather
Strong sunlight
questions.correct: Habitat loss

questions.text: A farmer moves from western Luzon (Type I) to Eastern Samar (Type II). How should he adjust his planting plan?
options: Expect no dry season; heavy rain late in the year
Expect six dry months, just like in western Luzon before
Expect snow during December and January
Expect no rain at all for most of the year
questions.correct: Expect no dry season; heavy rain late in the year

questions.text: A mountain has lowland forest at the base, mossy forest higher up, and grassland near the top. What BEST explains this pattern?
options: Conditions change with elevation
The soil gets saltier closer to the summit
The Sun is nearer to the top of the mountain
People planted each forest type on purpose
questions.correct: Conditions change with elevation

questions.text: Two plans aim to save the Philippine Eagle: A protects large forest areas; B breeds a few eagles in a city zoo. Which is MORE effective long-term?
options: Plan A — eagles need large wild forests
Plan B — zoos alone can replace the forests completely
Plan B — eagles prefer to live in busy cities
Plan A — because forests make eagles grow faster
questions.correct: Plan A — eagles need large wild forests
